statement: Generalize the champion's kept ncols==1536 RMSNorm float4/direct-mul specialization (akm-rmsnorm-1536-float4-384 +1.359%, akm-rmsnorm-1536-direct-mul-index +2.530%, in-tree at norm.cu rms_norm_f32<384,true,false,true> and its ncols==1536 dispatch gates) to the widths this rung actually dispatches. The live tg128 profile's fused-mul norm rows - rms_norm_f32<1024,true,false,false> (3.05%, 16,641 calls) and rms_norm_f32<256,true,false,false> (1.12%, 10,320 calls), 4.17% of device time combined - never enter the kept fast path because its gate is hardwired to ncols==1536 (the superseded screen-model width); they run the generic scalar branch of rms_norm_f32: per element a 4B x load, a per-element fastmodulo(col, mul_ncols_packed) weight index (mul_ncols==ncols for every fused RMSNorm weight here, so the modulo chain is pure waste), two muls, and the write pass re-reads x from global. Mechanically: when ncols%4==0 && mul_ncols==ncols && mul_nrows==1 (the same condition the 1536 gate asserts, minus the width), take a new rms_norm_f32<block,true,false,true> instantiation with block = min(1024, ncols/4) (5120 -> 1024 threads, one aligned 16B float4 per thread plus one predicated second for the 1280th-256th; 256..1023 -> ncols/4 threads, one each): one memcpy_1 float4 x load held in registers across block_reduce, 4 squares accumulated, then scale and multiply with one direct float4 weight load (no modulo) and one 16B store - x read from L1 once instead of twice, vmem instructions ~4x fewer per thread, all per-element mul/div-mod arithmetic gone. Per-element formula (scale*x_i*w_i) is unchanged; only the accumulation order of the row's square-sum changes, numerically-valid-not-bit-exact, the exact class the two 1536 keeps already passed through the MUL_MAT oracle. Norms feed every MMVQ/MMQ in the graph, so the effect is direct on the measured surface; expected class of gain tracks the 1536 pair's +1.4..+2.5% against a comparable share.
falsifier: A/B on tg128 (Qwen3.8-27B-Q8_0) vs champion fe881991f, 20 alternating pairs, floor 0.638%: if tg128 fails to clear the floor, OR rocprofv3 shows the combined per-launch device time of the two rms_norm_f32 instantiations essentially unchanged after the change (i.e. the scalar branch was already bound by the block_reduce/launch tail at these row counts and the loads/issue the patch removes were off the critical path), the mechanism is dead and the record is a bounded null. Guards: dec-b4 and dec-b8 must not regress (the same kernel change serves every batch width), and test-backend-ops RMS_NORM + MUL_MAT on ROCm0 must pass. Do NOT re-run the already-kept ncols==1536 pair; this patch only widens the gate the champion's own keeps built.
target_symbol: rms_norm_f32 kernel + rms_norm_mul_f32_cuda / rms_norm_f32_cuda dispatch gates (generalize the ncols==1536 float4/direct_mul branch)
